agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.2.0: export a private archive first (Settings > Download private archive, or rer export with local dev stopped). Run git pull in the existing checkout, then rer dev locally or rer deploy from the original deploying checkout for a hosted installation. Additive migrations 0037-0041 apply automatically; existing projects, evidence, triage states and project keys are preserved. Keep the existing database, local settings, project keys and deployment receipts; do not reset or restore into the populated installation. The import door in Settings > Business imports is off by default and needs the installation's owner-claim trust bindings (RER_OWNER_CLAIM_*); self-hosted rer deploy does not declare them. Local dev opens through its private RER_OPEN owner entry and suppresses mail. The application pins rer 0.2.49. SDK 0.2.0 remains unpublished on npm and is not published by this app release.
publicReleaseNotes: Spool 0.3.0 brings Sentry history in through Base's import door (off by default, undoable, inert history beside new errors) and adds full-corpus issue search and export, previewed bulk triage, complete Sentry exception chains, inbound filters, Sentry text feedback, SDK discard reports, recorded repository source links and alert email destinations managed from Alerts. Upgrading from 0.2.0 applies additive migrations 0037-0041 and keeps existing data. The release gate covered a local upgrade from v0.2.0, a door import of the repository's synthetic Sentry export, an unmodified Sentry Node SDK pointed at Spool, triage, the alert feed at 1440 and 390, and a fresh Cloudflare/SendGrid deployment with email sign-in and a delivered alert email. The importer is qualified with synthetic exports only. The app release does not publish the SDK.
